New Shingle Roof San Francisco | ROOF EXPRESSExpert Asphalt Shingle Roof Installation in San Francisco, CA
If you're planning a new shingle roof in San Francisco, you need a roofing system built for fog, moisture, wind, and coastal conditions. At ROOF EXPRESS, we specialize in installing high-quality asphalt shingle roofs designed to protect your home while enhancing curb appeal.

As a Diamond Certified roofing company and GAF Certified Installer, we provide durable, energy-efficient roofing systems trusted by homeowners across San Francisco.
Why Choose Asphalt Shingles in San Francisco
Asphalt shingles remain one of the most popular roofing options in San Francisco due to their versatility and performance:

Cost-effective roofing solution

Strong resistance to wind and moisture

Wide range of colors and architectural styles

Quick installation and easy repairs

Long lifespan (20–30+ years with proper installation)

When installed correctly, shingle roofs perform exceptionally well even in San Francisco’s coastal climate.
Our New Shingle Roof Installation Process
At ROOF EXPRESS, we follow a proven step-by-step installation system to ensure long-term durability:
1. Roof Inspection & Planning
We evaluate your existing roof, attic ventilation, and structural condition.
2. Tear-Off & Deck Preparation
Old roofing materials are removed, and we inspect and replace damaged plywood if necessary.
3. Waterproofing & Underlayment
We install high-quality synthetic underlayment and leak barriers in critical areas.
4. Shingle Installation
We install premium architectural shingles from trusted brands like GAF and CertainTeed using precise nailing patterns.
5. Final Inspection & Cleanup
We ensure everything meets our quality standards and leave your property clean.
Best Shingles for San Francisco Climate
Due to San Francisco’s unique weather conditions, we recommend:

Architectural (Dimensional) Shingles – Enhanced durability and wind resistance

Algae-Resistant Shingles – Ideal for foggy environments

Cool Roof Shingles – Improve energy efficiency by reflecting sunlight

Our team helps you choose the best materials based on your home’s location and exposure.
Signs You Need a New Shingle Roof
You may need a new roof if you notice:

Missing, cracked, or curling shingles

Roof age over 20 years

Leaks or interior water stains

Granule buildup in gutters

Uneven or sagging roof areas

Early replacement helps avoid costly structural damage.
Why Choose ROOF EXPRESS in San Francisco
Homeowners across San Francisco trust ROOF EXPRESS because we provide:

Diamond Certified quality workmanship

GAF Certified roofing systems

Transparent pricing and detailed estimates

Fast project timelines

Clean and professional job sites

We understand San Francisco roofing requirements and deliver results that last.
